title: 1.4 Ethical Issues in Biology
description: Ethical issues in biology and the ethical treatment of plants and animals during biological studies

questions.question: Ethical issues in biology concern ____.
options: the cost of building research laboratories
the number of species in an ecosystem
the rightness or wrongness of using biological discoveries for the health and wellbeing of humans
questions.correctAnswer: the rightness or wrongness of using biological discoveries for the health and wellbeing of humans

questions.question: Ethical issues in biology deal with concerns related to ____.
questions.correctAnswer: biotechnology, medicine, and the environment

questions.question: Ethical treatment of plants and animals during biological studies is ____.
options: the process of keeping animals in zoos
the process of subjecting animals and plants to various experiments and rigorous tests
questions.correctAnswer: the process of subjecting animals and plants to various experiments and rigorous tests

questions.question: Plants are ____.
options: primary producers and feeders for all living organisms
questions.correctAnswer: primary producers and feeders for all living organisms

questions.question: Trees properly function in ____.
options: decentralized forms without any centralized order-providing unit (brain)
centralized forms led by a brain
hierarchical systems with an order-providing brain
random forms controlled by the weather
questions.correctAnswer: decentralized forms without any centralized order-providing unit (brain)

questions.question: Subjecting plant species to severe life-threatening conditions leads to ____.
options: a total disappearance of plant species
questions.correctAnswer: a total disappearance of plant species

questions.question: Collecting seeds, berries, roots, leaves, bark or flowers for personal uses ____.
options: improves the color of the plants
affects the survival of the plant species and the community that depends on the plants
increases the number of plant species
questions.correctAnswer: affects the survival of the plant species and the community that depends on the plants

questions.question: Which of the following is an unethical treatment of plants?
options: Testing seeds or berries through destructive rays
questions.correctAnswer: Testing seeds or berries through destructive rays

questions.question: Which of the following is an unethical treatment of plants?
options: Planting trees as a national responsibility
questions.correctAnswer: Cutting tree terminals for experiments

questions.question: Which of the following is an unethical treatment of plants?
options: Consumption of all seeds and fruits without conservation
questions.correctAnswer: Consumption of all seeds and fruits without conservation

questions.question: Which of the following is an unethical treatment of plants?
options: Burning forests and seedlings for farmlands
questions.correctAnswer: Burning forests and seedlings for farmlands

questions.question: Which of the following is an unethical treatment of plants?
options: Respecting the physical materials of plants
Conserving the bark and roots of trees
Restructuring the shapes of trees for aesthetic appeal
questions.correctAnswer: Restructuring the shapes of trees for aesthetic appeal

questions.question: Unplanned cutting of trees or deforestation is ____.
questions.correctAnswer: an unethical treatment of plants

questions.question: Care for plants is an ethical treatment that is important for ____.
options: saving the jeopardized species and conserving them for our common future
questions.correctAnswer: saving the jeopardized species and conserving them for our common future

questions.question: It is ethical to plant trees, and it is ____.
questions.correctAnswer: a national responsibility

questions.question: Animals are sentient creatures that ____.
options: lack the ability to feel any sensation
function without any form of stress
have a nervous system, feel painful feelings and emotional stress, and have interests and values
questions.correctAnswer: have a nervous system, feel painful feelings and emotional stress, and have interests and values

questions.question: The ethical treatment of animals is a moral question of ____.
options: whether it is acceptable to harm animals for scientific research
how to increase the number of research animals
how to feed animals in laboratories
questions.correctAnswer: whether it is acceptable to harm animals for scientific research

questions.question: Given that animals are sentient creatures, ____.
options: it is acceptable to injure them in experiments
they can be used without any restrictions
it is unethical to harm them during experiments or rigorous testing
their suffering is not a concern
questions.correctAnswer: it is unethical to harm them during experiments or rigorous testing

questions.question: The three Rs principle used to reduce the impacts of unethical treatments of animals includes ____.
questions.correctAnswer: Reduction, Refinement, and Replacement

questions.question: Reduction aims to minimize ____.
options: the number of animals used in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: the number of animals used in experiments

questions.question: Reduction is achieved by ____.
options: improving experimental techniques and sharing information with others
using more animals in every experiment
questions.correctAnswer: improving experimental techniques and sharing information with others

questions.question: Refinement is cleansing experiments in a way that enables to reduce ____.
questions.correctAnswer: suffering of animals

questions.question: Refinement uses less invasive techniques, better medical care, and better ____.
questions.correctAnswer: living conditions

questions.question: Replacement is substituting experiments on animals with alternative techniques using ____.
options: cell cultures, biosynthesis, and computer simulated models
questions.correctAnswer: cell cultures, biosynthesis, and computer simulated models

questions.question: Which of the three Rs uses cell cultures instead of whole animals?
questions.correctAnswer: Replacement

questions.question: Which of the three Rs focuses on minimizing the number of animals used in experiments?
questions.correctAnswer: Reduction

questions.question: Ethical issues in biology are concerned with respecting the values for ____.
questions.correctAnswer: all life forms

questions.question: Ethical issues in biology deal with the rightness or wrongness of using ____ on human health, lifestyles and livelihood systems.
questions.correctAnswer: biotechnological information, products, or devices

questions.question: Ethical issues in biology particularly determine the right or wrong values that may affect human rights to ____.
options: equality to live freely and naturally
questions.correctAnswer: equality to live freely and naturally

questions.question: Ethical issues in biology deal with questions related to unethicality, immorality, illegality, inequality, injustice, and ____.
options: disrespectful acts to the values and rights of someone
respectful treatment of all living things
questions.correctAnswer: disrespectful acts to the values and rights of someone

questions.question: The commercialization and commodification of ____ is included among the concerns of ethical issues in biology.
questions.correctAnswer: human organs

questions.question: Which of the following is included among the concerns of ethical issues in biology according to the unit summary?
questions.correctAnswer: Assisted reproduction techniques

questions.question: The manipulation of basic biological ____ is included among the concerns of ethical issues in biology.
questions.correctAnswer: organ systems

questions.question: According to Inquiry activity 1.5, students invite a forester to discuss ____.
options: the unethical treatments of plants being practiced by human beings
the movement of bio-robots designed from kangaroos
the beak shape of kingfishers used in bullet trains
the use of GPS in landscape mapping
questions.correctAnswer: the unethical treatments of plants being practiced by human beings

questions.question: Inquiry activity 1.5 emphasizes respecting the ____ of plants.
questions.correctAnswer: physical and biological materials

questions.question: Inquiry activity 1.5 highlights the unethical uses of ____ of plant species.
options: seeds, leaves, roots, twigs, or barks
questions.correctAnswer: seeds, leaves, roots, twigs, or barks

questions.question: According to Inquiry activity 1.5, 'Trees give shadow even for an axe-man; everyone is responsible to ____.'
questions.correctAnswer: plant trees

questions.question: According to the unit review, care for plants is ____ treatment of plant species.
questions.correctAnswer: an ethical

questions.question: Replacing experimental animals with the use of biosynthetic tissues is considered ____.
options: an ethical treatment of research animals
an unethical treatment of research animals
a method of increasing food production
questions.correctAnswer: an ethical treatment of research animals

questions.question: According to Inquiry activity 1.6, students discuss with a zoologist the conservation of animals as ____.
questions.correctAnswer: sentient creatures

questions.question: Habitat, species, and ecosystem balance is a topic discussed with a ____ in Inquiry activity 1.6.
questions.correctAnswer: zoologist

questions.question: Unethical treatments of animals in research include approaches which expose animals to ____.
options: rigorous experiments that may injure or cause pain to animals
gentle handling with proper medical care
clean living conditions and good nutrition
less invasive techniques and better living conditions
questions.correctAnswer: rigorous experiments that may injure or cause pain to animals
